issues.location: The Power: Source Metadata section / overall completeness
issues.issue: The source explicitly presents two concrete examples of macro usage in Acutest: (1) TEST_CHECK capturing __FILE__ and __LINE__, and (2) TEST_LIST expanding into boilerplate code for the test function array. The wiki only includes the TEST_CHECK example. Dropping TEST_LIST also means the wiki never illustrates the 'eliminate repetitive boilerplate' motivation for macros, which the source lists as one of three reasons C uses macros ('eliminate repetitive boilerplate, avoid function call overhead for tiny operations, and capture source-code metadata').
Source table includes Zig's comptime as a compile-time eval alternative alongside C++ constexpr; wiki omits Zig entirely.
